'''Yolanda Kakabadse Navarro''' (born 1948<ref name="ed">Education Without Borders: ''[http://ewb.hct.ac.ae/mentors/yolanda-kakabadse/ Yolanda Kakabadse] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110217092327/http://ewb.hct.ac.ae/mentors/yolanda-kakabadse/ |date=February 17, 2011 }}''. URL retrieved 2011-01-24.</ref>) is an [[Ecuadorian]] [[conservation movement|conservationist]] of [[Georgia (Country)|Georgian]] descent.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://moe.gov.ge/index.php?lang_id=ENG&sec_id=40&info_id=1410 |title=Goga Khachidze Met President of WWF International Yolanda Kakabadse |access-date=2014-07-06 |archive-date=2016-03-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160309195814/http://moe.gov.ge/index.php?info_id=1410&lang_id=eng&sec_id=40 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Biography ==

After studies in [[Educational psychology]] at the University of [[Quito]],<ref name="ed"/> she became involved in environmental issues. She was a founder of the Fundación Natura in Quito and was its executive director from 1979 to 1990. At the [[Rio Earth Summit]], she acted as [[Non-governmental organization|NGO]] liaison.<ref name="teeb"/> In 1993, she was a founder of the Fundación Futuro Latinoamericano<ref>Fundación Futuro Latinoamericano (www.ffla.net)</ref> [http://www.ffla.net/ (www.ffla.net)] and served until 2006 as the executive president of this NGO. From August 1998 to January 2000, she served as Minister of Environment in the government of Ecuador.

From 1996 to 2004, she was president of the [[International Union for Conservation of Nature]] (IUCN)<ref name="hesselink">Hesselink, Frits; Čeřovský, Jan: ''[http://cmsdata.iucn.org/downloads/cec_history_annex_28sept08.pdf Learning to Change the Future]'', IUCN 2008, p.&nbsp;22. URL retrieved 2011-01-24. {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120302142833/http://cmsdata.iucn.org/downloads/cec_history_annex_28sept08.pdf|date=2012-03-02}}</ref> and from 2010 to 2017, she was president of the [[World Wide Fund for Nature]] (WWF).<ref name="wwf">WWF: ''[http://wwf.panda.org/who_we_are/organization/presidents/ Presidents past and present: Yolanda Kakabadse]''. URl retrieved 2011-01-24.</ref> She is also a member of Washington D.C.–based think tank the [[Inter-American Dialogue]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.thedialogue.org/experts/yolanda-kakabadse/|title=Inter-American Dialogue {{!}} Yolanda Kakabadse|website=www.thedialogue.org|access-date=2017-04-12|archive-date=2020-09-30|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200930193805/https://www.thedialogue.org/experts/yolanda-kakabadse/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Yolanda Kakabadse is also a trustee of the [[Ford Foundation]]<ref name="teeb">[[The Economics of Ecosystems and Biodiversity|TEEB]]: ''[http://www.teebweb.org/AboutTEEB/AdvisoryBoard/YolandaKakabadse/tabid/1076/Default.aspx Yolanda Kakabadse] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111008180957/http://www.teebweb.org/AboutTEEB/AdvisoryBoard/YolandaKakabadse/tabid/1076/Default.aspx |date=October 8, 2011 }}''. URl retrieved 2011-01-24.</ref> and was a board member of the [[LafargeHolcim Foundation for Sustainable Construction]] from 2004 until 2013.<ref name="holcim">LafargeHolcim Foundation: ''[https://www.lafargeholcim-foundation.org/experts/yolanda-kakabadse] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210624202731/https://www.lafargeholcim-foundation.org/experts/yolanda-kakabadse |date=2021-06-24 }}''. URL retrieved 2020-06-02.</ref>

Since 2017, Yolanda is the Chair of an [[International Union for Conservation of Nature|IUCN]]-led Independent Scientific and Technical Advisory Panel, the [https://www.iucn.org/rio-doce-panel Rio Doce Panel] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220224140749/https://www.iucn.org/rio-doce-panel |date=2022-02-24 }}, created to advise the restoration efforts at the Rio Doce watershed in Brazil, following the [[Mariana dam disaster]], in 2015.

Kakabadse is an [[Earth Charter]] International Commission member.
